title: fix(components): dropdown-menu rows and tabs reach a 44 px touch target at phone width
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6rhJS7ZbYPhkr8QGvprAUj)_

Fixes #29215

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:手机宽度(小于 sm 断点)下,所有下拉菜单的每一行(普通项、勾选项、单选项、子菜单入口)和所有 Tabs 标签页按钮的点击高度至少 44 px,Tabs 外框随之长高;桌面宽度下样式一字未改。
- **为什么改**:移动端 App 用 WebView 承载 Console,记录页「更多」菜单、列表行操作菜单和各处标签页都用这两个共享组件,原来菜单行 32 px、标签页 32 到 38 px,手机上容易点错。
- **风险与回滚**:只加了 `max-sm:` 前缀的样式类,桌面不受影响;手机上带固定高度的标签栏(如 AI 对话页的紧凑切换器)会变高。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`(新增的两组补丁声明)、`ui/packages/components/src/ui/tabs.tsx`(TabsList 与 TabsTrigger 两行)、`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/menu-tabs-touch-target-29215.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/menu-tabs-touch-target-29215.test.tsx scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`,预期全绿;或在 375 px 宽的 Console 打开任一记录页点「More actions」,每行高 44 px。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- Below `sm`, every `DropdownMenu` row is at least 44 px tall: `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuRadioItem` and `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` each gain `max-sm:min-h-11` right after their `py-1.5`. `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` is included because a phone user taps it to open the sub-menu; `DropdownMenuLabel` is not a control and is left alone.
- Below `sm`, `TabsTrigger` gains `max-sm:min-h-11`, and `TabsList` gains `max-sm:h-auto` at the end of its class string, so the list drops its fixed `h-10` there and grows with its triggers.
- From `sm` up, every class list is upstream's, token for token. No export, prop or `TabsContent` change.
- `dropdown-menu.tsx` and `tabs.tsx` are Shadcn-synced (`ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 7), so both edits are declared in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` as two new families, `dropdownMenuRowTouchTargetPatches` and `tabsTouchTargetPatches`, built by one small `phoneTouchTargetPatch` helper that inserts the phone class after a named token inside a registry anchor. The shipped files were written by applying those patches, and `pnpm shadcn:update` re-applies them. The checkbox and radio items share one upstream class string, so their anchor declares two occurrences.
- Both families are new to `LOCAL_PATCHES`, so the registry provenance test requires vendored fixtures: `ui/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/dropdown-menu.registry.txt` and `tabs.registry.txt`, captured verbatim from shadcn-ui/ui `8a7701ec27eb9cb8e0377db769fbe6d744113c52` through `raw.githubusercontent.com`. The same capture reproduces `dialog`'s recorded sha256 byte for byte. `tabs` round-trips byte for byte (`roundTrip: true`). `dropdown-menu` cannot, because it already ships the undeclared Tailwind v4 `origin-(--radix-…)` spelling that `shadcn-components.json` documents, so its entry pins the inequality with that reason, as `calendar` does.
- `ui/packages/components/shadcn-components.json`: the `dropdown-menu` `localEdits` note names the new patch beside the Tailwind v4 note, and `tabs` gains a `localEdits` note.
- Changeset `.changeset/29215-menu-tabs-phone-touch-target.md`: `@object-ui/components` patch.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/menu-tabs-touch-target-29215.test.tsx` (10 cases). For each of `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuRadioItem`, `DropdownMenuSubTrigger`, `TabsTrigger` and `TabsList`, the rendered element carries exactly the one phone class, and every other token equals upstream's list in order. A label and `TabsContent` get no phone class. A caller's own `py-2`, or `h-7` and `h-6`, still merge through `cn`, and the phone class survives them.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: provenance entries for the two fixtures, plus a new describe block. It checks the declared ids. Applied to registry bytes, each family adds only `max-sm:` classes, leaves every class string's other tokens identical in order, and adds exactly 4 `max-sm:min-h-11` for dropdown-menu and 1 `max-sm:min-h-11` plus 1 `max-sm:h-auto` for tabs. Only the four menu rows carry the floor, and `TabsList` still opens with `inline-flex h-10` (the opening `e2e/approvals-inbox-phone.spec.ts` reads it by). The family refuses when upstream re-pads the item (found 0x), and when the checkbox and radio rows stop sharing a class string (found 1x).
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/__snapshots__/snapshot-critical.test.tsx.snap`: the two "Tabs snapshots" regenerated with `vitest --update`. The diff is the `TabsList` and `TabsTrigger` class attributes only, gaining `max-sm:h-auto` and `max-sm:min-h-11`. A sweep of every `*.snap`, `*.test.*` and `*.spec.*` file for the upstream item, trigger and list class strings finds no other pin.
- Ablation, one-shot, at 43e61dbf, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, restore verified `git diff HEAD` empty): with `max-sm:min-h-11` dropped from `DropdownMenuItem` in the shipped file, 3 cases go red. They are "DropdownMenuItem: at least 44 px below sm, upstream classes from sm up", "a caller's own padding still merges, and the phone floor survives it" and "dropdown-menu.tsx carries its declared patches".

## Acceptance notes

- **Token choice.** The card asked for `min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0`. This PR uses `max-sm:min-h-11` and `max-sm:h-auto` instead, accepted by the seat before the build. It follows the shadcn-patch precedent on main (the Sheet close and Dialog close families are `max-sm:` only). It leaves every desktop token byte-identical to upstream, which the tests assert token for token. `sm:min-h-0` would also change desktop `min-height` from `auto` to `0`, which matters in a `flex-col` tab list (the vertical `tabs` renderer, `ViewSwitcher`'s vertical orientation). The helper #29072 landed (`touchTarget.ts`) is internal to `@object-ui/fields`, so `@object-ui/components` cannot import it either way.
- **Fixed-height callers grow on phones.** A `TabsList` or `TabsTrigger` given a fixed height by its caller still gets the phone floor, because `max-sm:` classes do not conflict with unprefixed ones in `tailwind-merge`. The AI chat page's compact assistant switcher (`h-7` list, `h-6` triggers) is therefore 45 px tall below `sm`. That is the card's intent: every tab strip.
- **Per-page phone arms now overlap the primitive floor.** `ApprovalsInboxPage` (`tabTouch`), `InboxPopover` (`TAB_TRIGGER_CLASS`) and `AppHeader` (`max-md:[&_[role=menuitem]]:min-h-11`) already lift their own tabs or menu rows below `md`. They still own 640 to 767 px, so nothing is removed here.
- **Not covered, same shape, not measured.** `ContextMenu`, `Menubar`, `Select` and `Command` rows have the same `py-1.5` shape upstream. This card names only DropdownMenu and Tabs.

## Verification

- Real browser: app-crm backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) plus the Console Vite dev server on source, Playwright, CRM account record page (`/apps/crm_app/crm_account/record/:id`). Before means main's `dropdown-menu.tsx` and `tabs.tsx`, with Vite restarted with `--force` before the leg; the files were restored from HEAD afterwards and `git status` was clean.
  - "More actions" menu rows (Refresh, Add to favorites, Share, Delete): 375 x 812, 32 px before, 44 px after. 1280 x 800, 32 px before and after.
  - The tab row's "+3" overflow menu rows (Contacts, Opportunities, Leads), 375 x 812: 32 px before, 44 px after.
  - `TabsTrigger` in real Chromium with real Tailwind (the installed `tailwindcss`, compiled for the class strings read out of each `tabs.tsx`): 375 px, trigger 32 to 44 px and list 40 to 52 px. 1280 px, trigger 32 px and list 40 px in both legs.
  - The record page's own tab row (Overview, Activity, …) is not this primitive. It is `RecordTabRow` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, an `h-9` button strip, so it measures 36 px in both legs and both widths. It is reported to the seat as a separate finding and is not changed here.
- Local gates at d67694b9 (main merged after #29204 landed): the 36 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff all exit 0, and the `--ran` reconciliation reads 36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. They include `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files, 4921 tests passed). `@object-ui/components` type-check (with `tsconfig.test.json`), `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts`, eslint on the five touched source and test files and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new) all exit 0, measured at 43e61dbf.
- At c25c35bc (main merged again, no incoming commit touches these 10 paths): the four touch-target component tests, `snapshot-critical`, the patch registry test and main's new `phoneCardRowActions-29150` re-run green (6 files, 111 tests), and `check-sdui-manifest` exits 0. The whole components package is left to CI Test UI.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
